turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Quick launch sync. Arjun is heads down on the usage meter today, so it's the three of us. Meera, how did the deck land?

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: The revised deck went to Saffron Basket yesterday, so that one is done. But their reaction to the Starter price was not great.

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: What did they actually say? Was it the price itself, or the shipment limit that bothered them?

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: The price. Trackwise just cut its small-shipper plan from 3,999 to 3,499, so at 4,999 we're over forty percent more expensive.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Is that just one customer pushing back, or are we hearing the same thing from other accounts?

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Other accounts too. Two of the five trial accounts that signed up this week asked for a price under four thousand.

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: I expected this, so I ran the numbers again last night. If Starter includes one thousand shipments instead of fifteen hundred, 3,999 still works.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Walk us through it, because on Tuesday you said 3,999 was below your floor.

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: A thousand shipments cost us about eighteen hundred rupees. At 3,999 that's a 55 percent margin, which is better than the 46 percent we accepted on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: And heavy users still pay four rupees per shipment above a thousand, so the busy accounts are covered.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: My worry is that a thousand shipments looks small next to Trackwise. What does their plan include?

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: The same thousand shipments. But they charge seven rupees for overage, so above about twelve hundred shipments a month we're the cheaper option.

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: Then I'm fine moving Starter to 3,999 with a thousand shipments. Overage stays at four rupees.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Okay, let's change it. Starter moves from 4,999 to 3,999 a month, with one thousand shipments included. This replaces what we decided on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Good. That makes my first calls a lot easier, especially when we're up against Trackwise.

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: The annual discount stays at fifteen percent, though. I don't want to reopen that one.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Agreed, fifteen percent stands. So what has to change downstream before launch?

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: The Starter plan in Razorpay needs to change. I'll update it to 3,999 with the new shipment limit by Monday.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: And I'm still drafting the pricing page, so it'll go out with 3,999 and the thousand shipment cap. That's still on track for Monday.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Change the FAQ example as well. Two thousand shipments on the new Starter would be 3,999 plus four thousand, so 7,999 rupees.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Yes, I'll use that. Someone needs to tell Arjun, because the usage meter warning was set at ninety percent of fifteen hundred.

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: Ninety percent of a thousand is nine hundred. That's a config value, isn't it, not a rebuild?

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: It should be config. I'll message Arjun today so the meter warns at nine hundred shipments, and he can still ship it on Friday.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: I'll email Saffron Basket and the two trial accounts with the new Starter price by tomorrow morning, ahead of their renewal call.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Does the November second launch date still hold with all of these changes?

turns.speaker: Rahul
turns.text: It holds. The GST registration is still pending, but I'll know by Tuesday, as planned.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Good. So to recap, Starter is now 3,999 a month with a thousand shipments, overage is four rupees, annual stays at fifteen percent, and we launch November second.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: And the Saffron Basket deck is done, with the price update going out to them tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Right, that's everything. Thanks, both of you. See you at Monday's standup.
